prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences from the modules Algorithms and Data Structures and Efficient Algorithms are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can evaluate and use known advanced data structures according to their performance characteristics.
Students can apply methods for the design of new data structures.
Students can apply methods for the analysis of data structures.
Students can refer to known lower bounds for impossibility results.

syllabus_topics: Amortization and potential functions, e.g. Splay Trees, Fibonacci heaps
External memory data structures and algorithms

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution of at least two of the exercise assignments. The final examination is a written exam or an individual oral examination. Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
